titleZh: 支持 ↔ 削弱｜加固隊 vs 挖牆腳
hook: 加固柱對挖牆腳鏟——論證語氣對打。

members.speakLineEn: Extra practice sessions helped bolster her confidence before the oral defense.
members.speakLineZh: 額外練習時段幫助支撐她在口試答辯前的信心。

related.antonyms: undermine, weaken, de-energise, de-energize, sedate, discontinue

members.speakLineEn: Two classmates could corroborate that he was in the library during the theft.
members.speakLineZh: 兩位同學能證實，竊案發生時他人在圖書館。

members.speakLineEn: Three professors agreed to endorse her application for the research internship.
members.speakLineZh: 三位教授同意認可並背書她的研究實習申請。

related.antonyms: advance, ahead, forward, front, veer, negate, first, decertify

members.speakLineEn: Student leaders vowed to uphold the honor code during every take-home exam.
members.speakLineZh: 學生領袖誓言在每次回家考試中維護榮譽守則。

members.speakLineEn: She continued to champion free tutoring for first-year students all semester.
members.speakLineZh: 她整學期持續擁護為大一新生提供免費課輔。

members.speakLineEn: The recovered security video helped vindicate him after weeks of unfair blame.
members.speakLineZh: 找回的監視錄影，在數週不公指責後幫他洗清嫌疑。

members.speakLineEn: The language festival ran under the auspices of the international student office.
members.speakLineZh: 語言祭在國際學生辦公室的贊助保護下舉行。

members.speakLineEn: Many voters still espouse the idea that public libraries deserve steady funding.
members.speakLineZh: 許多選民仍擁護公共圖書館應獲得穩定經費的想法。

members.speakLineEn: Constant late-night gossip can undermine trust inside a small project team.
members.speakLineZh: 持續的深夜八卦，會暗中破壞小型專題小組內的信任。

members.speakLineEn: Someone tried to sabotage the science fair by hiding the demo power cords.
members.speakLineZh: 有人試圖藏起展示用電源線，蓄意破壞科學展。

members.speakLineEn: The underground zine printed subversive cartoons that mocked strict dress rules.
members.speakLineZh: 地下刊物印出顛覆性漫畫，嘲諷嚴格服裝規定。

members.speakLineEn: Humidity and late nights can enervate even a usually energetic runner.
members.speakLineZh: 濕氣加上熬夜，能讓平常精力充沛的跑者也變得衰弱。

members.speakLineEn: Thick curtains help attenuate street noise during early morning study hours.
members.speakLineZh: 厚窗簾有助於在清晨自習時段減弱街上噪音。

members.speakLineEn: Missing bus schedules can hamstring students who work evening shifts off campus.
members.speakLineZh: 公車時刻對不上，會阻礙需要在校外上晚班的學生。

members.senseAnchor: 削弱 n. 健康；活力
members.zhGloss: 削弱 n. 健康；活力
members.speakLineEn: Endless group chats can sap your focus right before a difficult midterm.
members.speakLineZh: 沒完沒了的群組訊息，會在困難期中考前削弱你的專注力。

members.speakLineEn: Abandoned storefronts blight the once busy street near the old train station.
members.speakLineZh: 廢棄店面損害了舊火車站附近一度熱鬧的街道。

members.speakLineEn: One dishonest grade can taint an otherwise honest academic record forever.
members.speakLineZh: 一次不誠實的成績，可能永遠玷污原本誠實的學業紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: Please do not tamper with the lab scales; even a tiny shift ruins measurements.
members.speakLineZh: 請勿擅自破壞或亂動實驗秤；再小的偏移也會毀了測量。

members.speakLineEn: Skipping breakfast to the detriment of concentration is a common exam-day mistake.
members.speakLineZh: 為了趕時間不吃早餐而損害專注力，是考試日常見錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: In the novel, rebels plot to overthrow a king who ignores the starving villages.
members.speakLineZh: 小說裡，叛軍密謀推翻那位無視飢餓村落的國王。

related.synonyms: upset, derangement, subvert, overturn, overrule, override

members.speakLineEn: A cracked phone screen can mar an otherwise perfect graduation day photo.
members.speakLineZh: 破裂的手機螢幕，可能損害原本完美的畢業典禮照片。

related.synonyms: March, blemish, defect, impair, spoil, deflower

members.senseAnchor: 破壞傳統的；破壞偶像的
members.zhGloss: 破壞傳統的；破壞偶像的
members.speakLineEn: His iconoclastic essays challenged fashion rules the school had never questioned.
members.speakLineZh: 他那些破除傳統偶像的文章，挑戰了學校從未質疑過的時尚規範。

members.speakLineEn: A small government subvention kept the community theater lights on all winter.
members.speakLineZh: 一筆小小的政府津貼，讓社區劇場整冬燈火不熄。

members.speakLineEn: The committee would not budge on the safety rule, no matter how late the request.
members.speakLineZh: 無論申請多晚，委員會在安全規定上就是不肯改變立場。

members.speakLineEn: Her calm speech seemed to embody the values the scholarship committee admired.
members.speakLineZh: 她沉穩的演講，似乎體現了獎學金委員會所欣賞的價值。
